reviews.review: Independent source formulas verify every primitive pad anchor, area and bound; all custom pad anchors are checked, with local custom geometry explicitly excluded. A separate exact source drill/clearance oracle matches every drill and the complete report pair multiset. Changed layer-sanity, dense-cluster, thermal and testpoint findings follow the repaired source placement, source dimensions, finite report projection and F&B.Cu mapping; full added/removed objects and metadata deltas are retained. This is not an independent certification of those remaining heuristic rules.
